title: Go where the heart is washed clean
summary: This meets the grimy inner feeling left by envy, ego, and self-measuring. The line says holy company cleans more deeply than private polishing ever can.
takeaway: Seek the company that cleans the heart.
lifeApplication: Before doom-scrolling or stewing over someone else's life, leave the screen and sit near the one whose presence makes you simpler. Let that company wash the mind before comparison speaks again.

source.shortMeaning: The saints' presence washes ego and turns the heart toward Naam.
source.lifeApplication: When comparison dirties the mind, move toward holy company before feeding it.
